description_en: Retrieves the inspection items currently available to the user
description_zh: 获取用户当前可用的巡检项
kebab_example: aliyun advisor describe-advisor-checks --biz-language zh --product ecs --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAdvisorChecks

parameters.help_en: The code of the cloud service
parameters.name: product

Category.description_en:
The category of the inspection item. Valid values:

1: security compliance

2: performance efficiency

3: business stability

4: cost optimization

5: service quota
Category.description_zh:
巡检项分类：

1: 安全合规

2: 性能效率

3: 业务稳定

4: 成本优化

5: 服务限制

Code.description_en: The code of the inspection item

Description.description_en: The description of the inspection item, including recommended actions and instructions
Description.description_zh: 巡检项描述，推荐操作和操作说明
Description.example: CPU负载，公网带宽负载，内存负载百分比算法超过标准值过高

GmtCreated.description_en: The time when the inspection item configuration was created, in the yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss format
GmtCreated.description_zh: 巡检项配置创建时间，格式为yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the inspection item configuration was last updated, in the yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss format
GmtModified.description_zh: 巡检项配置更新时间，格式为yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss

Name.description_en: The name of the inspection item

OperateColumn.description_en: The operation field. Uses the JSON field defined in the frontend template or the action of the diagnostic suggestion
OperateColumn.description_zh: 操作字段，使用前端模板或诊断建议action中定义json字段

Product.description_en: The code of the cloud service

Status.description_en:
Indicates whether the inspection item is disabled. Valid values:

enabled: The inspection item is available.

disabled: The inspection item is disabled
Status.description_zh:
诊断项是否被禁用状态：

enabled: 可用

disabled: 禁用

Tips.description_en: A brief summary of the inspection suggestion
Tips.example: 请排查实例资源占用情况或升级实例规格

ViewColumn.description_en: The display columns, which specify the detailed configuration for displaying inspection item details in the console
ViewColumn.description_zh: 展示列，即控制台展示巡检项详情的具体配置
